item.mng: qutuγ-tu lanka-avatar-a erdeni-yin sudur-ača qamuγ burqan-u ǰarliγ-un ǰirüken kemegdekü-yin bülüg
item.coloph: gballhabčanpo-yin ǰarliq busuγ-iyar enedkeg-ün barsi venanhi-yin ǰokiyaγsan tayilburi-luγ-a nayiraγulǰu, ločhava ayaq-γ-a tegimlig go čhosgrub kyi orčiγuluγad orosiγulbai, tayidu-yin darumal sudur-ača takiǰu sineǰileǰü baγulγaqui-tur dandr-a kemekü baγsi ene lanka avatar-a-yin sudur-i dabtan kinaǰu orčiγulbai .
